discovery: Census current actual D/W hard failures under the real clock, using installed selected internal/coupled SF mask and stock weights. This is not a parent-label or TRACE trigger.

Use normal pointFaces -> complete incident cells. Propose two interior point stars co-occurring through a current bad cell/shared interior facet. The successful grammar uses one original interior point and one generated AP, so do not require both points to be generated cone APs.

Refuse either point on physical/coupled/zone interface; every incident core cell owned by this rank and alive. Collect entire stars, no truncation. Union <=128 cells and <=8 complete inherited normal origins; call collectCompleteOrigins before costly geometry copies.

Deterministically order by actual hard-D/W coverage and stable world-coordinate geometry. Equal complete geometry keys with differing native topology/source identities are ambiguous and refuse, not lowest-label tie.

For full core extract every facet with exactly one core endpoint as a literal exterior. Internal facets cancel in opposite orientation. All removed internal roles must be patch=-1/zone=-1. Exterior rings/point0, patch/type/BC/zone/source handle and actual outside endpoint are immutable.

Discover coordinate-axis support planes from the literal current/source-backed shell; no prescribed axis, separator value or parent list. The two original interior star points must be strictly opposite sides. Every outer facet must lie wholly on one side (or a proved supported separator boundary). A crossing outer facet needs external remeshing, so refuse this first grammar.

Directed outer edge cancellation on each side must leave a single simple four-original-node loop; the two loops must be exactly reverse-oriented and share coordinates. Strictly convex noncollinear exact axis-plane quad creates only an internal separator.

Each side must be closed and mathematically convex from exact oriented halfspaces, permitting support-plane ties only for shell coverage. Actual replacement cells still pass the unchanged installed stock concavity predicate; no legacy project or stock threshold is changed.

The two lobes partition the original closed shell exactly: every literal exterior appears once, separator appears twice with opposite orientation, exact V/M1 equal old full core, no positive pair intersection or uncovered volume. Closure alone is not a convexity or coverage proof.

hardCaps.admission: Every cap checked before copy/loop/reserve. Overflow refuses a complete candidate or stage; never truncate a star/halo. All sizes are future proposed bounds, not measured source acceptance.

finiteSeed.equations: For each lobe outward unit plane n_i dot x <= b_i, solve four active rows [n_ix n_iy n_iz 1] q=b_i with q=(x,y,z,r). All four-tuples, finite bounded 4x4 pivoted solver; reject singular/nonfinite/ambiguous condition. Require r>clearance and every plane visibility constraint.
finiteSeed.selection: Maximum feasible radius then stable world lexicographic tie, tolerance only generates proposals. Exact visibility and installed hard thresholds decide. No SciPy, optimizer-success coordinate, fixture plane ID, point ID or fixed source parent list.
finiteSeed.directGrammar: When both generated seeds are fully hard-green, accept only after full guards and record zero kernel requests. This is finite geometric seed grammar, not a 3D optimizer success.
finiteSeed.oneBadLobeGrammar: Only if exactly one lobe is hard-bad: reuse dcCartFiniteRepairKernel::propose dimension3, ObjectiveKind::DWeightCount, <=256 requests/32 iterations/384 projections. Keep other lobe geometry-derived seed fixed. Evaluate complete combined halo each trial; existing primary and best-hard checkpoint fractions 1/.95/.5/.25, same full guard and available callback.
finiteSeed.bothBad: Refuse first version; no unverified six-dimensional optimizer.
finiteSeed.numericalGuard: All final candidate values finite; original thresholds exact. Existing helper triangle arithmetic is not assumed bit-identical to installed geometry. Ambiguous rounded seed is refused/backtracked, never epsilon-treated as passing.

exactGeometryImplementationGap.existingState: Python Fraction and SAT proved this one template. No native exact coverage predicate was added with source authority. Current float tolerance/axis tests do not replace those certificates.

Scale/overflow/subnormal/expansion-cap ambiguity refuses. Compare 6V and 24M1 polynomial accumulations to avoid rational division. No new dependency install.
exactGeometryImplementationGap.scope: Axis separator exact support, nontri literal face planarity/convexity, directed edge cancellation, positive cone tetra cover, halfspace/SAT separation. Expansion implementation and tests are future work requiring separate approval.
exactGeometryImplementationGap.fixedProofNotImported: Finite replay had780 pair SAT/no-overlap tests,38 exterior/8 physical roles and exact V/M1; its static arrays are fixtures only, not discovery or source permission.

qualityAndLineage.determinant: Use actual stock selected SF (internal+coupled, physical excluded), normalized tensor determinant/8. All new replacement cells must pass .001; any removed old passing D role conservatively inherited by every replacement. Retained actual passing roles remain passing; hard counts strictly improve and bad worst does not worsen.
qualityAndLineage.facets: Literal exterior old role maps to the same facet with new inside endpoint and same outside. All passing W>=.05,R>=.01,S<=4 protected. Deleted internal roles require explicit conservative transfer to replacement internal facets; initial safest rule every replacement internal facet passes W/R/S if any removed face was passing. Never silently remove passing W as a D-only route.
qualityAndLineage.geometry: Actual stock cell concavity, exact shell orientation/closure, positive volumes and both centroid/shared-anchor tetra decompositions under installed minTetQuality; no coplanar-face threshold exception.
qualityAndLineage.warningN: N warning labels may change only within current actual warning count/max budget chosen by ROOT; use global real ceiling, not frozen88.2. Report old/new label/count/max separately. Not a Failed2 removal claim.
qualityAndLineage.coverage: No discarded material/cells. Full outer shell, physical BC/ports, ordered rings and source coverage stay; V/M1 exact. Source authority grants normal provenance only, not quality.
